verdict.info: \bFoxy Night\p, whose yard is enjoying a fine summer, is preferred to \bRajiba\p among those with experience after last Thursday's clear second at Southwell. \bGILDING THE LILY\p, a half-sister to a couple of useful winners, may well be up to the job on her debut however.[Graham Wheldon]

horses.comment: A year between her debut for Charlie Johnston and her comeback for this yard, and absent for seven months since; came in for good support at Southwell in January, though, when pulling too hard; worth a market check again.

infoForm.comment: took keen hold, midfield, headway from over 2f out, weakened inside final furlong
infoForm.caption: Southwell (AW)

infoForm.comment: prominent early, towards rear after 1f, outpaced inside final furlong, stayed on
infoForm.caption: Lingfield (AW)

horses.comment: Three solid efforts this summer, latterly when not quite seeing out 1m on her handicap/turf debut a fortnight ago; one to consider back on the AW and back down in trip.

infoForm.comment: soon prominent on near side of group, pressed leaders final furlong, weakened towards finish
infoForm.caption: Newbury

infoForm.comment: led, ridden over 1f out, kept on inside final furlong, headed inside final 110yds, lost second towards finish
infoForm.caption: Kempton (AW)

infoForm.comment: in touch with leaders, edged right over 1f out, kept on and went second inside final furlong
infoForm.caption: Wolverhampton (AW)

infoForm.comment: in rear, ran green but headway from over 1f out, no extra towards finish
infoForm.caption: Wolverhampton (AW)

horses.comment: Easy to back and finished well held on her 6f debut here last November; would want to see good support from the outside stall under 7lb claimer Molly Keegan-Price (0-7 to date) before including her in calculations.

Yard enjoyed a good month and this filly about sets the standard, having come away with an interesting newcomer at Southwell last Thursday; nothing wrong with her previous Ffos Las third either and she's respected in first-time headgear.

infoForm.comment: pressed leader, led over 1f out, headed inside final furlong, pressed winner inside final 110yds, just held
infoForm.caption: Southwell (AW)

infoForm.comment: midfield, headway under 2f out, bit short of room over 1f out, went third inside final furlong, kept on
infoForm.caption: Ffos Las

infoForm.comment: in rear, headway over 2f out, went third over 1f out, no extra final 110yds
infoForm.caption: Carlisle

infoForm.comment: in touch with leaders, switched right soon after start, no impression from over 1f out
infoForm.caption: Kempton (AW)

horses.comment: Debut Chester fifth well advertised since; looked to find the drop to 5.7f against her (stamina on the dam's side) last time following an awkward start and she's one to bear in mind; maybe in handicaps after today, though.

infoForm.comment: awkward start, midfield, outpaced 2f out, rallied final 110yds, not reach leaders
infoForm.caption: Bath

infoForm.comment: in rear, headway inside final furlong, not pace to challenge
infoForm.caption: Chester

horses.comment: Trainer saddled four big-priced winners on the spin early in the week; this filly would be the biggest shock of all, having finished well held in two turf runs.

infoForm.comment: in touch with leaders, edged right and weakened under 2f out
infoForm.caption: Hamilton

horses.comment: Big price for her Windsor debut recently, when finishing last after fluffing the start; will need a big step forward.
22,000euros yearling who's a half-sister to four winners; the market will show what's expected on debut but it wouldn't surprise were she to need some time.

250,000gns yearling who's a half-sister to Listed winner Brunch (twice successful on Tapeta) and useful handicapper Golden Voice (1-1 on Tapeta); looks to have been found the ideal race on her belated debut.
Half-sister to five-time turf winner Sunny Corner, who improved once handicapping (as did her dam, also for Stuart Kittow); no surprise to see her follow suit.
